actions.tree: LineComment: // 2007 is a common (non-leap) year with 365 days; 2008 is a leap year with 366 days. [4837,4922]
LineComment: // Shared fixture used by the field-access tests; the 12th day-of-year. [5155,5226]
LineComment: // Round-trip through serialization; readResolve must return the cached singleton instance. [7479,7570]
LineComment: // Every valid day-of-year reflects its value and is returned as a cached singleton. [8834,8918]
LineComment: // Walk every day of a non-leap year; the day-of-year runs 1..365 then wraps to 1. [9695,9777]
LineComment: // 'date' is now 2008-01-01, so the day-of-year resets to 1. [10103,10163]
LineComment: // Walk every day of a leap year; the day-of-year runs 1..366. [10334,10396]
LineComment: // from() on a DayOfYear returns the same instance. [10792,10843]
LineComment: // A non-ISO temporal is first converted to a LocalDate before extracting the day-of-year. [11012,11102]
LineComment: // A time-only temporal has no day-of-year to derive. [11321,11374]
LineComment: // "D" is the day-of-year pattern; parsing "76" yields DayOfYear 76 via the from() query. [11753,11842]
LineComment: // Only DAY_OF_YEAR (and a custom field that delegates to it) is supported; everything else is not. [12247,12346]
LineComment: // A custom field is queried by delegating to its getFrom(); it reads DAY_OF_YEAR. [16006,16088]
LineComment: // Day 366 exists only in leap years (2012 is leap; 2011 and 2013 are not). [16931,17006]
LineComment: // Day 365 is valid in every year, leap or not. [17275,17322]
LineComment: // DayOfYear answers chronology (ISO) and precision (DAYS); all other queries are null. [17763,17850]
LineComment: // Adjusting the first day of a non-leap year to day-of-year i lands on the i-th day. [18626,18711]
LineComment: // The starting point within the year does not matter; the result depends only on the day-of-year. [19135,19233]
LineComment: // Day 366 cannot be applied to a non-leap year. [19688,19736]
LineComment: // A leap year accepts all 366 day-of-year values. [20279,20329]
LineComment: // Adjustment is only supported on ISO date-times. [21160,21210]
LineComment: // Combining day-of-year i with a non-leap year yields the i-th day of that year. [21752,21833]
LineComment: // Day 366 has no corresponding date in a non-leap year. [22236,22292]
LineComment: // A year below the supported range is rejected. [24183,24231]
LineComment: // Compare every pair of day-of-year values; ordering must match the natural integer ordering. [24553,24647]
LineComment: // Two DayOfYear instances are equal iff they share the same value; each value is its own group. [25851,25947]
LineComment: // Pin the clock to each day of a non-leap year and confirm the reported day-of-year. [26896,26981]
